The '''Kourend & Kebos Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas in [[Great Kourend]] as well as the [[Kebos Lowlands]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from [[Elise]], south-east of the [[statue of King Rada I]] in the courtyard of the [[Kourend Castle]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.

==Easy==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Kourend & Kebos" data-diary-tier="Easy"

! style="width:50%;" | Requirements

|1. Mine some [[Iron ore|Iron]] at the [[Mount Karuulm mine]].
|
*{{SCP|Mining|15|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|-
|2. Kill a [[Sand Crab|Sandcrab]]{{sic}}.
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|3. Hand in a book at the [[Arceuus Library]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|4. Steal from a [[Fruit Stall|Hosidius Food Stall]].
|
*{{SCP|Thieving|25|link=y}}
|-
|5. Browse the [[Warrens General Store]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|6. Take a boat to [[Land's End]].
''Note: You have to travel with [[Veos]] or [[Cabin Boy Herbert]] from [[Port Sarim]] or [[Port Piscarilius]].''
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|7. Pray at the [[Altar]] in [[Kourend Castle]]
''Note: This altar is found on the top floor of the castle.
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|8. Dig up some [[Saltpetre (deposit)|Saltpetre]].
|
*[[Spade]]
|-
|9. Enter your [[Player-owned house|Player Owned House]] from [[Hosidius]].
|
*{{SCP|Construction|25|link=y}} {{Boostable|n}}
*8,750 [[coins]] for an [[estate agent]] to move your house to [[Hosidius]] (can only be done after you've visited [[Great Kourend]])
|-

''Note: The fishing spot is found south-east of the [[Farming Guild]].
|
*{{SCP|Fishing|20|link=y}}
*[[Fly fishing rod]] and some [[feather]]s (bring enough feathers to account for fishing raw salmon multiple times before you get a raw trout)
|-
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Rada's blessing 1]]:
**Three daily teleports to the [[Kourend Woodland]]
**2% chance to catch two [[fish]] at once anywhere when equipped, excluding at [[Tempoross]]' [[Tempoross Cove|Cove]] (no additional experience granted)
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill of at least level 30
*Entrance fee for the [[Crabclaw Isle]] lowered to 5,000 [[coins]], down from 10,000 [[coins]]
*Doubled chance at receiving a [[Xeric's talisman]] from [[Lizardman|lizardmen]], [[lizardman brute]]s, and [[lizardman shaman]]s (1/125, up from 1/250)
*20% discount on [[Eodan]]'s [[tanner|tanning]] services 
*Access to the [[range|cooking ranges]] in the [[Hosidius Kitchen]], which have an additive 5% increased success rate over other ranges
*The [[farming patch]]es in [[Hosidius]], south of the church, will never get [[Disease (Farming)|disease]]d

*{{SCP|Farming|45|link=y}}
|-

|{{NA|None}}
|-

|

*[[Hammer]], 3 regular [[planks]], and about 50 [[nail]]s of any variant
|-
|8. Deliver some [[intelligence]] to [[Captain Ginea]].

|
*{{SCP|Agility|49|link=y}}

|
*{{SCP|Firemaking|50|link=y}}
*Any [[axe]], [[tinderbox]], and [[warm clothing]]
*[[Knife]] and a [[hammer]] or [[Imcando hammer]] recommended to score more points

|12. Catch a [[Chinchompa (Hunter)|Chinchompa]] in the [[Kourend Woodland]].
|

*[[Box trap]]
|-

|
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|50|link=y}}
*Any [[axe]]
|}

=== Rewards ===
*[[Rada's blessing 2]]:
**Five daily teleports to the [[Kourend Woodland]]
**4% chance to catch two [[fish]] at once anywhere when equipped, excluding at [[Tempoross]]' [[Tempoross Cove|Cove]] (no additional experience granted)
**Has a [[Prayer bonus]] of +1 when equipped, similar to the [[God blessing|god blessings]]
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 experience in any skill of at least level 40
*Free access to [[Crabclaw Isle]], down from a fee of 5,000 [[coins]]
*40% discount on [[Eodan]]'s [[tanner|tanning]] services, up from 20%
*5% chance to mine two [[dense essence block]]s at once
*[[Thirus]] offers you 20 [[dynamite]] for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Dynamite}}*20}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]

*See the [[Lizardman shaman/Strategies|strategy guide]]

|
*{{SCP|Mining|65|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]

|
*{{SCP|Farming|74|link=y}}{{Boostable|yes}}
*[[Seed dibber]]

|
*[[Combat gear]] and a [[light source]]

*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Dream Mentor]]

*[[Lunar spellbook]] selected
*Means to cast [[Monster Examine]] ({{RuneReq|Astral=1|Mind=1|Cosmic=1}})
|-

===Rewards===
*[[Rada's blessing 3]]:
**Unlimited teleports to the [[Kourend Woodland]]
**Three daily teleports to the top of [[Mount Karuulm]]
**6% chance to catch two [[fish]] at once anywhere when equipped, excluding at [[Tempoross]]' [[Tempoross Cove|Cove]] (no additional experience granted)
**Has a [[Prayer bonus]] of +1 when equipped, similar to the [[God blessing|god blessings]]
*[[Ash sanctifier]], claimable from [[Tyss]]
**An additional item that, when carried, causes [[Remains#Demonic ashes|demonic ashes]] dropped from killed monsters to be automatically scattered, granting half the [[Prayer]] experience that would have been granted for scattering them normally
**This item is charged with [[death rune]]s
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 experience in any skill of at least level 50
*Any [[slayer helmet]] can be used in place of a [[Shayzien helm (5)]] for its [[Shayzien armour (tier 5)|protection]] against [[lizardman shaman]]s, after talking to [[Captain Cleive]] (requires having the helm in your [[collection log]])
*60% discount on [[Eodan]]'s [[tanner|tanning]] services, up from 40%
*5% increased chance to save a [[Farming#Variable crop yield|"harvest life"]] at the [[herb patch]]es in [[Hosidius]] and the [[Farming Guild]], slightly increasing your harvest yield
*[[Thirus]] offers you 40 [[dynamite]] for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Dynamite}}*40}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]

==Elite==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Kourend & Kebos" data-diary-tier="Elite"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Craft one or more [[Blood rune]]s from [[Dark essence fragments|Dark essence]].
''Note: This requires mining a [[dark essence block]] and breaking it down into [[Dark essence fragment|fragments]], then using those fragments on the [[Blood Altar (Kourend)|Kourend Blood Altar]].
|
*{{SCP|Runecraft|77|link=y}}, {{SCP|Mining|38|link=y}}, and {{SCP|Crafting|38|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]] and [[chisel]]
|-
|2. Chop some [[Redwood logs]].
|
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|90|link=y}}
*Any [[axe]]
|-
|3. Defeat [[Skotizo]] in the [[Catacombs of Kourend]].
|
*[[Dark totem]]
*See the [[Skotizo/Strategies|strategy guide]]
|-
|4. Catch an [[Anglerfish]] and cook it whilst in [[Great Kourend]].
|
*{{SCP|Fishing|82|link=y}} and {{SCP|Cooking|84|link=y}}
*[[Fishing rod]] and some [[sandworms]]
|-
|5. Kill a [[Hydra (disambiguation)|Hydra]] in the [[Karuulm Slayer Dungeon]].
Note: Either variant may be killed to fulfill this requirement. Only the [[Alchemical Hydra]] requires a slayer task to kill.
|
*{{SCP|Slayer|95|link=y}}
*[[Weapon]]ry
*[[Poison#Curing_poison|Antipoison]] recommended
|-
|6. Create an [[Ape Atoll teleport tablet]].
|
*{{SCP|Magic|90|link=y}}
*[[Arceuus spellbook]] selected
*[[Dark essence block]] and the required [[runes]] ({{RuneReq|Soul=2|Blood=2|Law=2}})
|-
|7. Complete a Raid in the [[Chambers of Xeric]].
|
*See the [[Chambers of Xeric/Strategies|strategy guide]]
|-
|8. Create your own [[Battlestaff]] from scratch within the [[Farming Guild]].
|
*{{SCP|Farming|85|link=y}} and {{SCP|Fletching|40|link=y}}
*[[Celastrus sapling]], [[knife]], [[spade]], [[rake]], and any [[axe]]
*8 [[potato cacti]] recommended to protect your sapling
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Rada's blessing 4]]:
**Unlimited teleports to the top of [[Mount Karuulm]]
**8% chance to catch two [[fish]] at once anywhere when equipped, excluding at [[Tempoross]]' [[Tempoross Cove|Cove]] (no additional experience granted)
**Has a [[Prayer bonus]] of +2, up from +1, the highest of any item in the [[Worn_Equipment#Ammunition_slot|ammunition slot]]
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*Roughly 11% more [[slayer reward point]]s from [[Konar quo Maten]]'s tasks, including milestone tasks
*10% additive success rate when using the [[range|cooking ranges]] in the [[Hosidius Kitchen]], up from 5%
*Permanent protection from the burning effect in the [[Karuulm Slayer Dungeon]] without the need for protective footwear
*Ashes scattered via the [[Ash sanctifier]] now grant full [[Prayer]] experience
*80% discount on [[Eodan]]'s [[tanner|tanning]] service, up from 60%
*10% additional [[blood runes]] from the [[Blood Altar (Kourend)|false blood altar]] (no additional experience granted)
*10% increased chance of obtaining higher-tier [[ore]]s in the [[Blast mine]]
*[[Thirus]] offers you 80 [[dynamite]] for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Dynamite}}*80}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
